_readme: Overreach champion CONCEPT art — Stage 0 of the animated-boss overhaul.
V2: MONSTROUS HUMANOIDS. V1 rendered all three as tragic elderly humans and was
rejected by Raheem — they read as characters, not bosses, and several had no
menace at all. The first batch is kept at out/bosses-v1-human/ for reference.
Monstrous changes the BODY, not the moral read. The Overreach premise is that
each champion walked their archetype's path past its end and it consumed them,
so the transformation IS the tragedy. Bible §14 bans automatic villainy, not
inhuman anatomy — these are tragic monsters, never cackling villains. No
snarling, no evil grins, no trophies.
Constraints that did NOT change: portrait modesty (M5.7) applies to monsters
too — armour, hide, robes, carapace, never sexualised anatomy. The Seraph
champion is Balanced-paralysis and must never read Fallen: no molten obsidian,
no black light, no horns, no hellfire. Infernal is player-exclusive.
These are NOT final assets. Each approved concept is cropped to <=168x168 and
handed to PixelLab create-character-pro as `reference_image`, which does the
pixelisation — hence painterly, not pixel art. Big bold silhouettes matter far
more than fine detail: at ~180px sprite height, fine detail is sub-pixel.
STYLE-REF IS OFF for exploration. At Mid strength the controlnet homogenised
the IDEAS as well as the register — every champion inherited the anchor's
cowl, skirt and neutral A-pose and the distinctive concepts were flattened.
Consistency belongs on the three CHOSEN designs, not on the exploration.

cast.line: A towering monstrous hag, gaunt and hunched with unnaturally long sinewy limbs, ashen grey-green leathery skin drawn tight over a heavy misshapen frame, a long jaw, sunken luminous eyes and thin white hair hanging in ropes. She is buried under an enormous load of iron: dozens of heavy iron counting-weights and thick chains heaped across her hunched back and shoulders, coiling down her overlong arms and pooling in a great pile around her clawed feet, so much that the iron is the largest shape in the picture and she is bowed forward beneath it, still standing, enduring rather than straining. Ragged heavy sackcloth and boiled leather wrappings cover her body completely. Sorrowful exhausted expression, not angry. Muted cold grey iron, ashen grey-green hide, oxblood leather, old bronze.

states.label: Debt-Bearer B — Iron grown into her
states.line: A towering monstrous hag into whose body the iron has GROWN: heavy black iron counting-weights and chain links erupt directly out of her hunched spine, shoulders and forearms, fused into the flesh where metal and ashen grey-green hide have knitted together, a ridge of hanging iron stones running down her back like a second spine. Gaunt and enormous, long sinewy limbs, a long jaw, sunken luminous eyes, thin white rope-like hair. Ragged sackcloth and boiled leather wrappings cover her completely. She stands hunched and patient, head low. Sorrowful and tired, not angry. Muted cold grey iron, ashen grey-green hide, oxblood leather, old bronze.

states.label: Debt-Bearer C — Dragging the chain
states.line: An enormous hunched monstrous hag whose impossibly long arms reach the ground, dragging behind her a vast tangle of heavy iron chain and counting-weights that trails across the floor and heaps in the distance, the chain fastened to thick iron cuffs bolted through her wrists. Gaunt heavy frame, ashen grey-green leathery hide, long jaw, sunken luminous eyes, thin white hair in ropes. Ragged heavy sackcloth and hide wrappings cover her completely. Head bowed, still walking forward. Sorrowful and exhausted, not angry. Muted cold grey iron, ashen grey-green hide, oxblood leather, old bronze.

states.label: Still Season A — Root colossus
states.line: A towering monstrous humanoid grown entirely out of living wood and moss, three times the height of a man: a massive barrel torso of knotted grey bark and packed green moss, vast heavy arms of braided root reaching to the ground, thick root-legs splayed and gripping the earth. Where its head should be there is only a small withered ancient face set deep in the bark, eyes open and unfocused. Dozens of small green leaves hang suspended and completely motionless in the air all around it, none of them falling. Sorrowful and still, not angry. Muted olive, umber, grey bark and deep moss green, with a soft warm gold-green glow deep inside the chest cavity.

states.label: Still Season B — Bloated overgrowth
states.line: A colossal bloated humanoid mass of unstoppable growth, a swollen mound in the rough shape of a hunched giant: dense layered moss, thick knotted roots, ferns, creepers and pale fungal shelves piled over and through it until almost nothing structural is visible, two heavy root-arms hanging at its sides and a single gaunt bark-covered face pressed into the front of the mass near the top, eyes open and sorrowful. Everything is green and thriving and far too much of it. Muted olive, umber, deep moss green and grey bark, with a soft warm gold-green glow buried deep inside.

states.label: Still Season C — Deadwood cage + blossom
states.line: A tall gaunt monstrous humanoid of grey deadwood and pale blossom: a lean elongated figure whose body is a cage of bare woven branches with a hollow chest, long thin branch-limbs ending in splayed twig fingers, and a smooth featureless bark head with no eyes and no mouth. Perfect unwithered white and pink blossoms grow thickly along its shoulders, arms and ribs, and more hang suspended completely motionless in the air around it. Still and mournful. Muted grey bark, olive and umber against soft pale blossom pink and white, with a faint warm gold-green glow inside the hollow chest.

states.label: Unclosed A — Four pairs of arms
states.line: A towering monstrous figure in heavy bone-white ceremonial plate armour with FOUR pairs of arms, every pair frozen at a different point of the same unfinished gesture, palms open and empty, caught between offering and refusing. The armour is plain, unornamented, bone-white and cool pearl grey, fully enclosing the body. Where its face should be the helm is smooth and featureless, and thin pale gold light pours out through every seam and joint of the armour in all directions at once, casting no single direction of shadow. Imposing and sorrowful, never cruel. Bone-white, pearl grey and thin pale gold against deep neutral charcoal.

states.label: Unclosed B — Split down the midline
states.line: A colossal monstrous figure of interlocking bone-white plate armour divided perfectly in half down the exact vertical centre line of its body into two completely different but equally beautiful treatments that refuse to resolve: the left half rigid, cool pearl grey, hard angular faceted plate; the right half flowing, warm ivory and pale gold, smooth organic curves and drapery. Both halves are luminous, polished and pristine, and neither is dark, damaged or corrupt. It stands rigidly straight and perfectly symmetrical, too tall and too broad to be human, with a smooth featureless helm and pale gold light bleeding from the seam that divides it. Imposing and sorrowful. Pearl grey, warm ivory and pale gold against deep neutral charcoal.

states.label: Unclosed C — The long vigil, immense
states.line: A vast monstrous figure of bone-white ceremonial plate that has stood unmoving so long the world has closed over it: thick grey dust banked on its shoulders, dense sheets of cobweb strung between its raised arms and its body, pale green verdigris flooding every seam of the metal, and grey stone grown up over its feet and lower legs into a rough pedestal that roots it to the ground. It is far taller and broader than a person, fully armoured, with a smooth featureless helm and both arms still raised halfway in an unfinished gesture, palms open. Thin pale gold light still pours undimmed from its open palms. Sorrowful and immense. Bone-white, pearl grey, dust grey, verdigris green and pale gold against deep neutral charcoal.
